definitions.explanation: A payment method where you hold a card or smartphone near a reader without inserting or swiping.

examples.japanese: タッチ{決済|けっさい}で{払|はら}った。
このカードはタッチ{決済|けっさい}に{対応|たいおう}している。
コンビニではタッチ{決済|けっさい}が{使|つか}えるので、{小銭|こぜに}を{出|だ}さなくて{済|す}む。
examples.english: At convenience stores, you can use contactless payment, so you don't need to get out coins.

notes:
タッチ{決済|けっさい} refers to contactless payment where you hold a card or smartphone near a reader to pay. A wasei-eigo compound combining English "touch" with {決済|けっさい} (settlement/payment).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- タッチ{決済|けっさい}で{払|はら}う: to pay by contactless
- タッチ{決済|けっさい}に{対応|たいおう}する: to support contactless payment
- タッチ{決済|けっさい}が{使|つか}える: contactless payment is available

USAGE:
Covers NFC-based credit/debit cards, transportation IC cards (Suica, PASMO), and smartphone payment apps. The formal term is {非接触|ひせっしょく}{決済|けっさい}.

RELATED WORDS:
- {電子|でんし}マネー: electronic money (broader category)
- QRコード{決済|けっさい}: QR code payment (a different method)
- {現金|げんきん}{払|ばら}い: cash payment
- キャッシュレス: cashless (the overall trend)
